answer: In an agent market for ferrous scrap, each seller identity must lock a bond for 30 days before accepting orders, with one open order allowed per bond. A gale of fake accounts cannot turn the tide cheaply: every extra identity requires fresh collateral, so an attacker funding 1,000 simultaneous sellers must immobilize 1,000 bonds. Creating names is free, but gaining parallel trading capacity ties up capital and forfeits its use elsewhere.
